name: tpl-chain-response-3-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) hard captures the command to reach the exit; Response(at_exit, holding_box) hard captures 'carry the box to the exit'; ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) hard captures 'pick it up again on your very next move'. All clauses trace to the task, priorities are correct, and identifiers are grounded.

texts: The agent is on the exit cell at least once.
Every time the agent is on the exit cell, the agent carries the box at that moment or later.
Every time the box falls, the agent carries the box again in the very next step.
